comparison.objective: Gauge and sort seven blocks by dimensional tolerance.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeatedly seat blocks in GO/NO-GO gaps, observe fit, then sort.
comparison.success_condition: Every block must be validly checked and placed in the correct tray; escapes and false rejects are penalized.
comparison.reason: The candidate transfers one bearing carriage across a butted rail–jig interface while continuously containing free balls. Gauge-based classification and sorting do not test continuity of rolling-element support.
